claims.assertion: Anéeka doubts full UFO disclosure will occur; she says revelations will serve controllers’ agendas and could include a staged invasion using Blue Beam technology.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: She predicts acknowledging extraterrestrials would undermine human science and evolution narratives and encourage people to see themselves as stellar and free.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: She says disclosure of free energy and transport technology could collapse economies, while the Federation maintains the terrestrial Matrix partly to preserve Earth-based experiences.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as a motive within her account.
